metadata.phase: Phase 9.2 — Canonical Identity Additive Migration Plan

fields.migration_rule: Retain existing PRIMARY KEY. Existing TEXT IDs (28-char Firebase UIDs or UUIDs) are preserved without modification.
ADD COLUMN supabase_uid UUID NULL. Backfill for the 173 post-migration users where users.uid = auth.users.id::text. For legacy users, populate lazily on first OTP login.
ADD COLUMN phone_e164 TEXT NULL. Backfill with deterministic E.164 strings (+2010..., +966...). Must remain NULLABLE until all 287 accounts without phone are verified.
ADD COLUMN country_code TEXT NULL. Backfill with standard calling codes (+20, +966, +974, etc.) derived from E.164 normalization.
Standardize to lowercase snake_case ENUM: (player, club, academy, trainer, agent, marketer, admin). Backfill from existing accountType.
Retain existing email. Sanitize to LOWER(TRIM(email)). Email remains optional/nullable for phone-first accounts.
Standardize column to is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true. Map NULL values to true.
Standardize column to is_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false. Backfill true for accounts with authenticated phone numbers or auth.users match.
Consolidate camelCase createdAt into snake_case created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now().
Consolidate camelCase updatedAt into snake_case updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(). Add automated trigger for on-update.
Consolidate lastLogin into last_login_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL. Update on every successful authentication session.

phone_identity_rule.systemRule: ONE REAL PHONE NUMBER = ONE CANONICAL ACCOUNT
phone_identity_rule.operationalPrinciple: No two distinct accounts can own the same phone number regardless of account_type (e.g. player +2010... and club +2010... cannot exist as separate accounts).
pathwayToEnforcement: 1. Backfill phone_e164 additively without unique constraint.
2. Reconcile Class B legacy user/player pairs into 1 Canonical Account + 1 Profile Extension.
3. Reconcile 54 orphan profiles to parent accounts.
4. Resolve 24 Real Conflict groups via customer care outreach.
5. Clean up 21 isolated test data accounts.
6. Enforce partial unique index: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_phone_e164_unique ON users(phone_e164) WHERE phone_e164 IS NOT NULL;

workflow.description: Mark accounts in users with phone_conflict = true in metadata JSONB.
Extract real identity profiles, registration dates, and activity scores (videos, messages, notifications).
Contact both account holders via in-app banner or WhatsApp support.
Secondary holder updates mobile phone number to an owned, unshared SIM.
Verify new phone via Supabase Auth OTP before releasing the shared phone.
Update secondary account phone_e164 to verified new phone.
Once all 24 groups are unblocked, the unique constraint is guaranteed to succeed.

SAFE_DELETE.description: Isolated test/seed accounts with 0 foreign keys, 0 videos, 0 messages, 0 notifications.
SAFE_DELETE.action: Eligible for cleanup in Phase 9.3 after customer confirmation.

REQUIRES_REFERENCE_CLEANUP.description: Test/seed accounts with test chat threads, sample notifications, or test videos.
REQUIRES_REFERENCE_CLEANUP.action: Requires explicit cascade deletion script for child test records before account purge.

REQUIRES_MANUAL_REVIEW.description: Ambiguous test numbers (e.g. repeated 0111111111) mixed with potentially real club/academy demo profiles.
REQUIRES_MANUAL_REVIEW.action: Requires human confirmation before removal or phone detachment.

parentIdentityGenerationRules.step1_check_phone_match: If orphan profile shares phone with an existing user in users, evaluate if they are the same human individual. If yes, link profile to that user id.
parentIdentityGenerationRules.step2_generate_parent_user: If no parent exists, generate a parent user record in users with id = profile.id, account_type = table_singular, phone_e164 = normalized_phone, is_active = true, is_verified = false.
parentIdentityGenerationRules.step3_manual_review_threshold: Profiles with missing or invalid phones (e.g. 70542458) require admin review to assign valid contact details.

rules.nullable: NON-NULLABLE (Profile must have a valid parent identity)
rules.on_delete: ON DELETE RESTRICT (Prevents accidental account deletion while preserving historical and business records)
rules.on_update: ON UPDATE CASCADE (Ensures ID consistency across both identity and profile)
rules.cascade_safety_rule: DO NOT CASCADE DELETE ON BUSINESS ASSETS (videos, messages, notifications, opportunities, favorites). Zero automated cascade on assets.

profile_phone_columns_classification.justification: Duplicate of users.phone; canonical phone will live in users.phone_e164.
Derived calculation duplicate; canonical normalized phone will live in users.phone_e164.
Pre-normalization snapshot; no longer needed once users.phone_e164 is canonical.
Historical audit log field; can be archived.
Critical athlete safety contact field (parents/guardian of minor players).
Critical scouting contact field (FIFA licensed agent contact).

Player athletic nationality / country of competition.

migration_sequence.title: Additive Identity Columns
migration_sequence.sql_operations: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS supabase_uid UUID NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS phone_e164 TEXT NULL, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS country_code TEXT NULL;
migration_sequence.rollback: ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS supabase_uid, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS phone_e164, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS country_code;
migration_sequence.validation: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = users AND column_name IN (supabase_uid, phone_e164, country_code);

migration_sequence.title: Populate Identity Fields
migration_sequence.sql_operations: UPDATE users SET phone_e164 = phoneNormalized, country_code = countryCode WHERE phoneNormalized IS NOT NULL; UPDATE users SET supabase_uid = auth.users.id FROM auth.users WHERE users.uid = auth.users.id::text;
migration_sequence.rollback: UPDATE users SET phone_e164 = NULL, country_code = NULL, supabase_uid = NULL;
migration_sequence.validation: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE phone_e164 IS NOT NULL;

migration_sequence.title: Resolve Orphan Profiles
migration_sequence.sql_operations: INSERT INTO users (id, accountType, name, phone, phone_e164, country_code, isActive, isVerified, createdAt) SELECT id, player, name, phone, phoneNormalized, countryCode, true, false, now() FROM players WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM users); (Repeat for clubs, academies, agents).
migration_sequence.rollback: DELETE FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM orphan_backup_temp);
migration_sequence.validation: SELECT count(*) FROM players WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM users); -- Must return 0

migration_sequence.title: Resolve Duplicate and Conflicting Phones
migration_sequence.sql_operations: Execute Phase 9.3 Conflict Resolution script: reassign phones for the 24 conflict groups and isolate test clusters.
migration_sequence.validation: SELECT phone_e164, count(*) FROM users WHERE phone_e164 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY phone_e164 HAVING count(*) > 1; -- Must return 0

migration_sequence.title: Create Indexes
migration_sequence.prerequisites: Migration 4 completed (Zero duplicate phone_e164 in users)
migration_sequence.sql_operations: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_phone_e164_unique ON users(phone_e164) WHERE phone_e164 IS NOT NULL; CREATE INDEX idx_users_supabase_uid ON users(supabase_uid) WHERE supabase_uid IS NOT NULL;
migration_sequence.rollback: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_users_phone_e164_unique; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_users_supabase_uid;
migration_sequence.validation: SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = users AND indexname = idx_users_phone_e164_unique;

migration_sequence.title: Create Foreign Keys
migration_sequence.prerequisites: Migration 3 and Migration 5 completed (All profiles have parent user)
migration_sequence.sql_operations: ALTER TABLE players ADD CONSTRAINT fk_players_users FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE; (Repeat for clubs, academies, trainers, agents, marketers, admins).
migration_sequence.rollback: ALTER TABLE players DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_players_users; (Repeat for 6 tables).
migration_sequence.validation: SELECT conname FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname LIKE fk_%_users;

migration_sequence.title: Switch Application Reads
migration_sequence.sql_operations: Update backend API and Flutter queries to read phone exclusively from users.phone_e164 and profile data from child table.
migration_sequence.rollback: Revert API query endpoints to read legacy profile phone columns.
migration_sequence.validation: Integration tests & smoke tests on phone lookup and profile fetch.

migration_sequence.title: Remove Legacy Duplicated Identity Columns
migration_sequence.prerequisites: Migration 7 completed and stable on production for minimum 14 days
migration_sequence.sql_operations: ALTER TABLE players DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS originalPhone, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS previousPhone, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS phoneNumber; (Repeat for profile tables). Do NOT drop guardian_phone or agent_phone.
migration_sequence.rollback: Restore columns from cold schema backup if needed.
migration_sequence.validation: Verify profile tables no longer contain redundant identity phone fields.

unique_phone_constraint_sql.proposed_sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_phone_e164_unique ON users (phone_e164) WHERE phone_e164 IS NOT NULL;
unique_phone_constraint_sql.justification: Using a partial unique index (WHERE phone_e164 IS NOT NULL) guarantees uniqueness for all phone numbers while safely accommodating the 287 accounts without phone numbers until they complete mobile OTP onboarding.

blockers_before_unique_constraint: 1. 24 Real Conflict Groups (106 accounts) sharing identical phones must be reassigned unique SIM numbers.
2. 21 Test data duplicate clusters (82 accounts) with repeated dummy numbers must be isolated or cleaned up.
3. 54 Orphan profiles must have parent rows created in users before foreign key creation.
4. 287 Accounts without phone require partial index handling (WHERE phone_e164 IS NOT NULL).
